items.html:
Recommend 0.1.1: substantial CPU gains, unchanged public API and solver tolerances.

The main documentation correction is large-clusters.md:151: with B = min(P, 8), Krylov/solution storage is O(N M (B R + P) + B R²). The statement that each worker holds an M × M pair block is obsolete. Explain independent convergence per column, shared translations, and the advantage of reused dense LU for repeated or strongly coupled solves.

Other updates:

  • Describe the configured thread count as a ceiling in the threads guide; update the exact product policy in design/numerics.md and design/parallelism.md.
  • Add the new performance page to mkdocs.yml, regenerate llms.txt with just docs, and add its provenance row to performance/evidence.md.
  • Retain historical timings unchanged, but label and link them clearly so users see current CPU results.
  • Remove first-release wording from development/releasing.md; update version-specific installation/support prose.
  • Set Cargo.toml, generated Cargo.lock, CITATION.cff, and dated changelog to 0.1.1. The editable uv.lock entry has no version; the formal package and mocked test versions are independent.

Publication sequence is unambiguous:

  1. Complete just ci, wheel, license, dependency-policy and formal checks; merge and await successful push CI on the exact main SHA.
  2. Confirm 0.1.1 is unused on PyPI, TestPyPI and Git tags; dispatch the existing release workflow.
  3. Wait for tested TestPyPI installation and the production approval job.
  4. Create the annotated tag at the workflow’s candidate SHA, push it, then approve the release environment.
  5. Await versioned docs, GitHub release, PyPI publication and clean installation. Verify 20 wheels + one sdist + checksums + provenance, and version/latest/root docs including rustdoc.

Keep main fixed during publication. Formal verification is a separate workflow, not part of CI Success. A failed TestPyPI candidate consumes its version.

Read-only audit completed; no files, Git state, PR state or external resources changed.
